import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to load fully
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    # Look for contributor links; from the tree, potential contributors might be under specific roles
    # Use a more specific selector based on common GitLab structure
    contributor_links = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text=re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z\s]+"))  # Filter for alphabetic names with spaces
    count = await contributor_links.count()
    if count > 0:
        await contributor_links.first.click()
        # Wait for the profile page to load
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
        # Extract details from the profile page
        full_name = await page.get_by_role("heading", level=1).inner_text()
        gitlab_account = await page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text=re.compile(r"@\w+")).first.inner_text()
        location = await page.get_by_text("Location:").inner_text()
        email = await page.get_by_role("link", name=re.compile(r"^[\w.%+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$")).inner_text()
        # Print the results as-is without processing
        print(f"Full Name: {full_name}")
        print(f"GitLab Account: {gitlab_account}")
        print(f"Location: {location}")
        print(f"Email: {email}")
    else:
        print("No contributor links found.")
